title: R package that depends on a non-CRAN remote
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN.
limitation: It matches a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN in the parsed DESCRIPTION; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
